name: Giacomo "GiacoLenzo2109" Lenzini
biography: Giacomo Lenzini is an Offensive Security Specialist and Red Teamer at EY Italy, and an independent security researcher. His work focuses on adversary simulation, red team operations, and penetration testing. He has received recognition from organizations such as NASA and has identified several vulnerabilities with associated CVEs.
